note: search_index.rs changes are outside ranking and query code. The new reconcile_borrowed_snapshot_with_disk runs only for a borrowed snapshot with worktree.ram_overlay on. The artifact key changes only for sessions opened in a subfolder of a checkout, since top-level and worktree keys are byte-identical. The ignore fingerprint changes only how info/exclude is named, not what it contains. The loader gained a coverage check that refuses an artifact written from a different checkout position. The benchmark runs from a repository top level, so the corpus, indexed content and ranking are unchanged.
